statement: SYNTHETIC notes about simulated people. Research artefact; not a medical device; not for clinical use.

inputs.decoding: greedy, at most 384 new tokens, same prompt as the first evaluation

selective.score: mean log-probability of the generated JSON tokens (adapter)
selective.rule: threshold = lowest score on the validation notes such that the notes at or above it have an error rate at or below the limit; fixed there, then applied unchanged
selective.validation_note: the validation notes took no gradient step; 50 of them were used to monitor validation loss during training

in_sample_for_comparison.note: threshold chosen on the same notes it is scored on, as in the first evaluation; optimistic by construction
threshold chosen on the same notes it is scored on, as in the first evaluation; optimistic by construction

adapter_all_test.note: adapter only; the base model was run on the first 200 test notes only, so the paired comparison stays on those 200

pathway_order_check.documented_order: SYMPTOM_ONSET_REPORTED <= FIRST_CONTACT <= PHYSICIAN_ASSESSMENT <= REFERRAL_SENT <= REFERRAL_RECEIVED <= DIAGNOSIS <= MDT_DECISION <= SPECIALIST_VISIT <= TREATMENT_START
pathway_order_check.sampler_order_differs: the sampler (scribe/sample.py) puts SPECIALIST_VISIT before DIAGNOSIS; SPECIALIST_VISIT before MDT_DECISION; the documented order has them the other way round
pathway_order_check.consequence: the adapter was trained on the training ones and is scored on the test ones

eventlog_validator.how: eventlog/validate.py run on pathway_events tables built from the ground-truth targets (placeholder county, site, age band and source; the order check does not read them)

split_overlap.cause: the sampler (scribe/sample.py) hashes entry route plus events to choose the split, so the same events with another route can land in another split

dedup_report.rule_used_for_dataset_v1: the first cached row of an id is kept whatever its verdict
dedup_report.consequence: accepted notes of the first kind were dropped and their id filed under rejected; dataset-v1 is left as built because the adapter was trained and scored on it
